summary: Calendar now names the long-video days in its heading, draws long thumbnails landscape, and marks long videos apart from Shorts.
why: Reading the Calendar code (free of the 7-day rule today) found the heading spoke only of Shorts and every thumbnail was drawn 9:16; the 'Long' marker was the oldest open Calendar idea. All checks pass (68 smoke tests).
